title: Spyglass: Now Officially Launched
summary: The Spyglass tool has officially launched, delivering its powerful capabilities to empower all users with enhanced insights and greater efficiency.

title: Enhanced File Management in the Editor
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your embedded files with a dedicated management area, enabling seamless uploads, downloads, and customizable display options right in the editor.

title: Introducing Our New Public Roadmap
summary: We've launched a dynamic new public roadmap that allows you to easily track our progress, review recent updates, and preview exciting future features.

title: Smarter, Sleeker Checkboxes
summary: Experience effortless organization with our redesigned checkboxes, now boasting a modern look, easier clicking, and simple drag-and-drop functionality.

title: Enhanced Real-time Collaboration
summary: Our latest enhancements deliver a more intuitive and responsive real-time editing experience, making team collaboration effortlessly productive.

title: Enhanced Sharing and Collaboration
summary: Users can now easily find and collaborate on shared items with their connections, making teamwork more seamless and productive.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: Soon, Noeko will be available in many more languages, connecting users around the globe with a seamless and localized experience.

title: Noeko: Now Open Source!
summary: We're thrilled to open Noeko's development to the community, empowering you with unparalleled transparency and direct involvement in its exciting future.

title: Enhanced Graph View: Discover and Connect
summary: Transform your graph view into a powerful hub for discovery and workflow, empowering you to effortlessly filter by tags, time, and shared content for richer insights and seamless collaboration.

title: Advanced Search & Curated Knowledge Collections
summary: Efficiently locate and organize your information by applying powerful filters and sorting options, then save your tailored searches as custom collections for quick access.

title: Dynamic Note Previews and Layouts
summary: Transform your note-taking experience with dynamic content previews and streamlined layouts that mirror your unique thinking process.

title: Empower Your Workflow: Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your data with Noeko's new self-hosting option or scale your capabilities with our upcoming premium cloud-hosted plans.

title: Elevate Your Experience with New and Improved Themes
summary: Get ready for a stunning visual upgrade as we enhance current themes and introduce exciting new ones, allowing you to perfectly customize your interface.

title: Enhanced Time-Based Greetings
summary: We're updating our greetings to dynamically adjust to your local time, ensuring a perfectly tailored welcome every time you visit the homepage.

title: Direct Control Over Tagged Items
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content by performing essential actions like unapplying tags, deleting items, and viewing details, all directly from the tag view.

title: Unlock More Content Formats
summary: We're dramatically expanding the types of content you can bring into the platform, including YouTube videos, websites, and text, so you can gather insights from all your favorite formats.
